notes: Discovery covers policy analysis/evaluation, public administration, governance, infrastructure policy and science/technology policy. Scope-fit statements are candidate mappings, not acceptance decisions.

Six Sage journals explicitly rule out submission/publication fees for standard subscription articles. Optional OA, print colour and paid services are excluded. Generic page-charge wording remains visible for the fee auditor; no compulsory standard-page trigger was identified.

Three subscription candidates need verification: Policy Sciences and Science and Public Policy lack explicit submission-fee exclusions; Journal of European Public Policy author instructions were blocked. Indexed no-APC text alone does not settle total fees.

Journal of Public Policy is a conditional counterexample because current Cambridge policy says wholly OA; it is not counted as unconditional free. No APC price, impact factor, indexing claim, acceptance rate or difficulty score is asserted by this discovery role.

Official Sage overview pages display acceptance percentages without the period/denominator in retrieved text, so none were copied to metrics. Ranking leads: https://journals.sagepub.com/overview-metric/ARP ; https://journals.sagepub.com/overview-metric/EVI ; https://journals.sagepub.com/overview-metric/AAS .

No preprints, repositories or blogs are included. No venue was contacted and no manuscript submitted. Official policies were checked live on the recorded date; this is agent discovery pending independent fee/ranking/review passes.
